title: policy-lens-rbacv2-tracepoints-and-kms-origin-scorer
author: Lena Weiss
release_notes: Adds Policy Lens tracing and lightweight tenant-aware audit sampling; introduces KMS origin scorer to surface anomalous key usage. Backwards compatible; gated behind feature flag 'policy_lens_v1'.
description:
Context: Customers have asked for better explanation and observability into RBAC v2 decisions without shipping full audit logs to downstream systems. This PR implements 'Policy Lens' — lightweight, explainable decision tracepoints coupled with a tenant-aware audit sampler and a KMS-origin scoring heuristic.

Motivation: reduce mean time to diagnose policy denials, surface cross-tenant key-origin anomalies, and limit audit volume using stratified sampling.

What this changes: 1) new decision explain tracepoints in the PDP path, exposed over the existing /decision/grok gRPC endpoint as an opt-in DecisionExplain protobuf (proto changes under proto/pdp/decision_explain.proto). 2) middleware/audit/stratified_sampler.go implements per-tenant stratified sampling buckets (low/medium/high sensitivity) with configurable rates via Console. 3) cmd/kms/origin_scorer.go adds a heuristics engine that scores KMS header provenance (provider mismatch, region jitter, reused-key fingerprints). Scores surface as a decision attribute so Policy Lens can attach a "kms_origin_score" to sampled audit rows and tracepoints. 4) metrics and dashboards: added metric policy_lens.tracepoints.count, policy_lens.sample_rate{bucket}, kms.origin_score.histogram and new dashboard JSON under observability/dashboards/policy_lens.json. 5) feature gating and rollout: guarded by feature flag policy_lens_v1 and a console toggle for sample rates; a migration to add a lightweight DB table (policy_lens.samples_v1) with TTL-based retention is included.

Checklist: - [x] proto definitions and generated Go stubs - [x] unit tests for sampler and scorer - [x] integration tests for PDP trace propagation - [x] dashboard and alert proto - [x] console toggle wiring - [x] short runbook section for incidents (see docs/ops/policy-lens-runbook.md)

Commits summary: "initial policy lens scaffolding", "proto: decision_explain v1", "middleware: stratified audit sampler", "kms: origin scoring heuristics", "metrics: policy_lens + kms origin histograms", "docs: runbook + console wiring", "tests: e2e trace propagation"

Files changed (high-level): - proto/pdp/decision_explain.proto (+ generated stubs) - pkg/pdp/decision_lens.go (core tracepoint emitters) - middleware/audit/stratified_sampler.go - cmd/kms/origin_scorer.go - observability/dashboards/policy_lens.json - migrations/20251002_add_policy_lens_table.sql - docs/ops/policy-lens-runbook.md - console/frontend/src/features/policyLens/Toggles.tsx - tests/integration/policy_lens_trace_test.go

Review thread summary: "Arjun Patel: overall looks good, please tighten scorer thresholds and document false-positive modes." "Lena Weiss (author): lowered default threshold from 0.6 -> 0.75; added config and notes in runbook." "Maya Chen: approve after addressing CI flake on TestSamplerRates (seen in CI summary)." "Diego Alvarez: requested a privacy review note — sampler must not change PII retention; author added a privacy-preserving description and retention TTLs in migration."

CI and checks: CI pipeline initially failed on TestSamplerRates (flaky timing assertion) — fixed with mocked clock in middleware tests and rerun. Unit tests: pass. Integration tests: pass. E2E: non-blocking flaky timeout retried and passed on rerun.

Security review: internal sec-review flagged KMS header parsing; added stricter validation and canonicalization (cmd/kms/origin_scorer.go).

Performance: microbenchmark shows <0.5ms median added latency on PDP hot path with the tracepoint early-exit when not sampled.

Rollout plan: enable policy_lens_v1 for 5% of tenants for 48 hours, monitor policy_lens.tracepoints.count, policy.decisions.latency, kms.origin_score.p95, and audit.ingest.volume. If stable, edge-roll to 25% then 100% over two weeks.

Runbook excerpt (short): If tracepoint volume spikes unexpectedly, toggle policy_lens_v1 off; if kms.origin_score p95 > 0.9 for many tenants, escalate to security on-call and run the included origin-scorer diagnostic script (docs/ops/policy-lens-runbook.md#diagnostics).

Merge outcome: merged via squash on main after approvals from Arjun and Maya; no DB destructive changes.

Related: ENG-1912 tracks polish items (console UX for sample rate), SEC-84 is the security review ticket.

Notes: This PR was deliberately conservative—tracepoints are small JSON blobs attached to sampled audit rows and are only emitted when tenant sampling indicates. The KMS origin scorer is pluggable: configuration supports multiple provider fingerprints and a soft-fail mode to avoid blocking requests.
